body.eli5: Each box is one step the picture goes through, from top to bottom. Click any box to learn about it.
body.simple: Each box is one layer, numbered like the Ultralytics YAML. Arrows carry the feature maps; their sizes are written on them. Click any box, arrow band or step for an explanation.
body.engineer: One node per YAML layer (index = YAML index); edges labelled with C×H×W; dashed edges are lateral/skip connections. Click for details, hover to highlight neighbours.

title: Choose how simple the words are

body.eli5: Pick 'Like I'm 5' for the simplest words, or 'Engineer' for all the details.
body.simple: Every explanation exists in three versions. You can switch at any time; underlined words show a definition when you hover or focus them.
body.engineer: Three reading levels for all content; Engineer adds equations and references.

body.eli5: Slide left to see only the big parts, right to look inside a box.
body.simple: L0 shows only the stages, L1 the layers, L2 the parts inside a block, L3 every small operation, L4 the code and math. Scrolling far in or out also changes the level.
body.engineer: Semantic zoom L0–L4 (stages → layers → block internals → primitives → code/math); wheel/pinch thresholds can be disabled.

body.eli5: Press play and watch the picture travel through the model, one step at a time.
body.simple: The walkthrough moves through the layers in order and tells you the map size after each step.
body.engineer: Step-through of the forward pass with output shapes per layer.

title: Change the model in the Lab

body.eli5: In the Lab you can add, remove and swap boxes, and ask the AI helper for ideas.
body.simple: The Lab lets you edit the architecture with live checks, compare with the original, export an Ultralytics YAML, and use the AI Architect for your own goal.
body.engineer: Operation-based editing with validation, undo, diff, YAML import/export and AI patches.
